title: Projection of the completion unit is the finite scalar-extension unit
statement: For a small site S and a commutative ring A, let R be its canonical strict derived quotient-tower functor for an ideal I, C = Rlim R, eta its specified unit, E_n tower evaluation, and F_n left derived scalar extension to A/I^(n+1). Let p_n be the limit projection defined by the normalized constant/limit adjunction and e_n : E_n R ≅ Res F_n the canonical finite evaluation isomorphism [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. For every N in D(S,A), eta_N followed by p_n and e_n is the unit of the finite scalar extension/restriction adjunction.

source.place: Tag 099M; the strict derived limit of Tag 0941 and scalar adjunction of Tag 06YY

proof.text: The normalized constant/limit adjunction gives its derived counit on an ordinary tower complex: apply the adjunction hom-set bijection, its prescribed unit, naturality of the derived-limit comparison, and the ordinary triangle identity. Factorizations for exact derived functors identify the diagonal/evaluation composite with the identity.

source.place: Tag 099M; the strict derived limit of Tag 0941 and scalar adjunction of Tag 06YY

proof.text: On a flat-term K-flat complex P, the defining quotient-presentation law expresses eta as the quotient augmentation followed by the derived-limit comparison. Evaluate the preceding counit equation at n. The ordinary augmentation followed by the limit projection is the ordinary finite tensor-unit map. The normalization of finiteAdjunction gives this same map. Cancel the invertible K-flat extension comparison.

from.place: Projection of the completion unit is the finite scalar-extension unit

lean.statement:
theorem completionUnitFiniteProjection (S : Site.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (N : S.derived A) (n : ℕ) :
    (S.unit A I).app N ≫
          (show S.delta A ⋙ S.evaluate A n ≅ 𝟭 (S.derived A) from
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
              (NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ ↦ Iso.refl _) (fun _ ↦ by rfl)) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso (S.modules A)).inv.app
              ((S.completion A I).obj N) ≫
          (S.evaluate A n).map ((S.deltaAdjunction A).counit.app
            ((S.reduction A I).obj N)) ≫
          (S.finiteEvaluationIso A I n).hom.app N =
        (S.finiteAdjunction A I n).unit.app N
